reason: Machine lens, not refuted. Opcodes: PHY, PLY, INC A, BRA, LDA abs,X, SBC abs,X are all real 65SC12 opcodes; there is no BBR/BBS/RMB/SMB/WAI/STP and no decimal mode. Assembly: I applied the candidate to a scratch copy of src/ and Baron assembled it for ship, release, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW, SKY_HELI=0, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW+SKY_HELI=0 and all GAMEPLAY_* (plus release). The bench SHIFT=256 SHIFT_END=1 build fails with 'bank 5 overruns by 239' with or without the candidate, so that failure was already there. The listing gives mark_to_draw &9790-&97DD, all in page &97, with every branch in range. c1_rec = &97AF is the operand of LDA rec_xh,X (BD 80 B5). It is written only by the STA c1_rec at entry, from render.classify_xh (&9283), which holds LO(rec_xh) OR boff (&80 or &C0, high byte &B5), so it gives the same address as the old TXA/ADC boff/TAY. Nothing else writes it. Page crossings: act &BC6E+Y, movers_* &1300/&1344/&1366+X and rec_xh &B580/&B5C0+X with X < &22 never cross a page. Carry: C=1 from the passing SBC holds through LDA, BMI, INC A, BNE, STA, PHY, TAY, AND and TAX into is_left_c1_3d13 (&1CAE), which expects C=1, X=type, Y=x high and mover_x_low set. The inline 16-bit right test matches the callee's CPY/BCC/BNE/CMP right edge. PHY/PLY stay balanced, and PLY keeps C for the BCS. Per slot, new against old: shown and on screen 39 vs 42, off the right 25 vs about 42-100, candidate on screen 82 vs 84-88; no path is slower. The 7-byte slide makes the gather loop's BRA (&97FA -> &9801 back to &97E2) cross a page, about +1 a listed slot; the BEQs at &9CFC and &9DD0 change crossing too. Measured: passbench, seed 1, passes 500-2000, ship build, original vs candidate: render 23432 -> 23213 cycles a pass (-219, the slide included). Fields, late frames and arena figures are identical. Bytes: +7 (59 old, width_of_type_A plus mark_to_draw's replaced lines, to 66 new), so the claim's -7 bytes saved is right.
